references.text: An alternative offering for the poor that also includes oil and silver pieces shows the same cleansing ritual with adjusted requirements.
Requirement of a one-year-old lamb without defect as a sin offering, the same principle of perfect sacrificial animals.
The eighth day is mentioned as the time for cleansing rituals, parallel to the purification offering after childbirth.
The grain offering of fine flour mixed with oil, the same type of offering mentioned in the verse.
Fine flour mixed with oil as a grain offering, the same sacrificial tradition.
The eighth day as the time for sacrifice, parallel to the conclusion of the Nazirite vow.
A tenth of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil as a grain offering, the same measurement system and type of offering.
Three tenths of fine flour mixed with oil per bull, the same amount mentioned in Leviticus 14:10.
The Old Testament sacrificial system points forward to Christ's perfect sacrifice that cleanses from all uncleanness.
